# `aitbc explorer chain-head`

Get the current chain head and its latest block height.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer chain-head [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer chain-head
```
